text:
Anna: Quick sync on Optimize toolkit delivery — need owners/ETA for quant recommendations, batching/caching suggestions, and regression alerts for next week's demo. Who's owning what? @Jose @Chris @Maya

Jose: I'll own quant recommendations. PR is in staging: https://git.internal/redwood/optimize/pull/432 — needs perf validation. ETA: EOD Wed for initial recs.

Chris: I'll assemble the eval harness (perf + regression tests). Need the exact model variant names from Jose and any special tokenization notes. Also the batching experiments require stable infra (canary GPU pool) — pinging @Maya for that.

Jose: Model variants: redwood-ggml-13b-q4, redwood-quant-7b-q5, redwood-7b-fp16. FYI saw ~3-5% token accuracy drop on q5 for sequences >2k during offline tests.

Maya: Infra heads-up: new CUDA image rollout scheduled Tue 2024-04-12 across dev clusters — could shift perf baselines. Recommend we run canary on the dedicated node pool before running the full batch experiments. I'll reserve 1 node pool for canary runs and post the access details.

Leo: I'll own docs + SDK integration bits. Plan: migration guide + short sample snippets for batching/caching. Want a tiny example in the PR?

Chris: Yes please. Example batching/cache config we'd like to test (copy into PR description):

```json
{
  "batching": {"max_batch_size": 32, "max_latency_ms": 50},
  "cache": {"prefix_cache": true, "cache_ttl_ms": 300000}
}
```

Jose: Adding regression alert hooks to the eval pipeline. Proposal: alert if latency increases >10% or quality metric (BLEU/ROUGE/ExactMatch) drops by >1.5 points vs baseline. Can we make thresholds per-route?

Anna: +1 on the thresholds. Prefer per-route config so demo-critical routes can have tighter guards. @Leo can you surface that in the UI and as env flags?

Leo: Yep — will add per-route toggles in Optimize GUI and expose env vars for programmatic pipelines. Targeting a PR by Thu.

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: staging/optimize-toolkit v0.9.3 -> 2024-04-11T22:00Z

Maya: I'll coordinate the canary and post perf numbers into #eng-metrics after the canary runs. If the CUDA image changes results significantly, we should rebaseline before merging Jose's recs.

Anna: Thanks — I'll compile this status into the roadmap doc and ping the demo/sales folks once we have quant recs + canary perf. If any ETA slips, update this thread.

Chris: Quick question — for long-sequence evals, do we want to include KV-cache warmup traces or cold-start only?

Jose: Include both. We observed differences: warm cache cuts latency ~18% for prefix-heavy workloads. Capture both in the eval report.

Anna: Perfect. I'll mark ownership: Jose (quant recs), Chris (eval harness & regression tests), Maya (infra/canary), Leo (docs + UI flags). Will update roadmap and set a checkpoint meeting Thurs morning if needed.

Leo: I'll open the docs PR and link it here when ready.

Anna: Great — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
